description.value:
You learn to unravel a tech power as it's being cast. When a hostile creature casts a tech power that targets you or includes you in its area, you can use your reaction to force an Intelligence save against your tech save DC. On a success, the power resolves normally.

On a failure, the power's effects are negated, the caster takes 1d6 lightning damage per level of the power, and its tech focus overloads, unusable for casting tech powers for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the caster can repeat the save, regaining use of its focus on a success.

You need a long rest before using this feature again.
